sources.snippet: In this notebook, the process of fine-tuning a pre-trained BERT-based model (DistilBERT) for the task of Named-Entity Recognition (NER) will be explored. NER is a fundamental task in Natural Language Processing (NLP) that involves identifying entities such as persons, locations, and organizations in text.
